none: PAS LANCUM-242413: Roman, Medieval or Post Medieval brick (probably)
contea di ritrovamento: Cumbria (Inghilterra e Galles)

Large, thick sherd, brick, roof tile or part of kiln furniture, possibly of Roman date. The sherd is made of dark red fabric and it is very worn. The edges are smooth and the original shape of the vessel or tile remains unknown. It seems that the outside/upper side was stamped, but the only two letters remaining are 'PN'(?) and their meaning is not clear
